# Offline parser fixtures

The files directly in this directory are a minimal, deterministic set of
compact synthetic schema fixtures for `readjsa` examples and offline tests.
They are generated and maintained in this repository; they contain no
production observations and are not extracts of live releases.

Each packaged file is an exact byte-for-byte copy of the corresponding source
fixture under `tests/testthat/fixtures/`:

- `ivi_skill_states.xlsx` — `tests/testthat/fixtures/ivi_skill_states.xlsx`
- `reos_current.xlsx` — `tests/testthat/fixtures/reos_current.xlsx`
- `salm_sa2.csv` — `tests/testthat/fixtures/salm_sa2.csv`
- `ivi.html` — `tests/testthat/fixtures/ivi.html`
- `reos.html` — `tests/testthat/fixtures/reos.html`
- `salm.html` — `tests/testthat/fixtures/salm.html`
- `salm_sa2_resource.html` — `tests/testthat/fixtures/salm_sa2_resource.html`
- `salm_lga_resource.html` — `tests/testthat/fixtures/salm_lga_resource.html`

The XLSX fixtures are generated by
`tests/testthat/fixtures/generate-fixtures.R` (which requires `writexl`). The
CSV and HTML fixtures are maintained alongside that generator in
`tests/testthat/fixtures/`. They are intentionally small so that parser and
discovery workflows can run offline, quickly, and reproducibly.

The `official/` subdirectory is separate from those synthetic fixtures. It
contains one exact, provenance-documented JSA workbook used to render the
end-to-end time-series chart without live network access. See
`official/README.md` for its source, release identity, checksum, attribution
and reuse terms.
